mechanism_narrative: A persistently elevated federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers persistent monetary policy restraint, causing S&P 500 forward returns to decline over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal accelerating residential investment, which strengthens consumer demand and corporate revenue outlook, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in residential investment (RSAFS) indicates strong household spending momentum that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate combined with slowing payroll growth indicates monetary tightening cooling labor market activity, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS rising and PAYEMS growth slowing fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 102.0 during a supply shock indicates severe output disruption, reducing corporate profitability and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 102.0.
